    result_ok = result == expected

    normalized = all(k == \"w\" for k in backend.keys)

for label, ref in [(\"HEAD\", \"HEAD:\"), (\"staged\", \":\")]:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=\"preference-review-\") as directory:
        for name in files:
            target = pathlib.Path(directory) / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"show\", ref + name]))
        print(f\"{label} test suite\", flush=True)
        tests = subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"-B\", \"-m\", \"unittest\", \"discover\", \"-s\", \"tests\", \"-v\"], cwd=directory, capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(tests.stdout + tests.stderr, end=\"\", flush=True)
        print(f\"suite exit={tests.returncode}\", flush=True)
        print(f\"{label} contract scenarios\", flush=True)
        scenarios = subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"-B\", \"-c\", scenario_code], cwd=directory, capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(scenarios.stdout + scenarios.stderr, end=\"\", flush=True)
        if scenarios.returncode:
            raise SystemExit(scenarios.returncode)
